answer: Each challenge is committed to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value is unpredictable until a quorum signs it, then mixed into the task instance and verified during response. Thus a sybil swarm cannot precompute valid solutions, stockpile identities, or farm offline; its work must follow each live pulse. Whether labeling a sonnet, mapping a dune, or recognizing a lotus, every attempt is bound to fresh, unbiasable randomness.
